review.note: Retracted in M21: 25 July 1972, Américo Tomás returned unopposed by the National Assembly for a third seven-year term that would have run to 1979. The mechanism — a presidency filled with no electorate in it — is already wired on the election of 1965, and repeating that argument against a second target would be padding. The one thing this election adds, that Tomás’s survival tied Caetano to the war, is a single edge and one is not two.
